{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Xarxis''''' was a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Reb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle group ''Xarxis'' appears in a training mission in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].
